pages.text: The augmentation chamber is used to install $(l:mechanics/installables)parts. $() You can place installable parts in the top-left slot, and then use the install button to add them. $(br2)The slot to the right of the top-left slot shows the currently selected $(l:mechanics/installables#body_parts)Body Part$(), this may need to be first selected on the right to install certain augments.

If you hover over something in the slot above the install button, it will provide information on the part, such as complexity. $(br2)If you right click whilst hovering over a part, it will swap to the ability display mode, listing the abilities of the part. You can use scroll-wheel to cycle between abilities. $(br2)When installing augments, be mindful of $(l:mechanics/complexity)complexity$().

On the right of the augmentation chamber screen is the body part display, where you can swap between display tabs on the right. $(br2)You can hover over a Body Part to see the installed Augments, and you can use scroll wheel to cycle between Augments, then hold right-click to remove an Augment.

Body Parts and Segments, unlike Augments, will always replace something when installed. For example, if you try to install a Cybernetic Brain, it will try to replace whatever part you have of the Brain type.
